notes: No production Compose, host driver or system package change.
Headless is a lab-only env flag; default remains headed.
The existing fixture was reused; no new HTTP endpoint was added for Phase 5.
WebGL evidence is the per-launch probe: renderer, pixel readback and hardware_verified.

GPU rasterization/compositing feature status is captured from Chromium SystemInfo; headed hardware reports software compositing under Xvfb while rasterization is forced. Screenshot medians are measured, not a speedup claim.
The phase-3 wire accepts either a render-pool context or a drive session as worker work; drive_sessions is a real worker status count.
Final phase-5 image includes GPU rasterization/zero-copy flags for hardware modes, Chromium feature-status probe and drive_sessions status.
